newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Morrow Snowboards cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Morrow Snowboards cut.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth said Friday it had downgraded Morrow Snowboards Inc to hold from buy based on continued sluggishness in the showboard industry.
-- Dain Bosworth believes Morrow's product continues to have strong momentum, but it is concerned that excess inventories of other brands could impact re-order demand among Morrow's customers.
-- Morrow's long-term outlook remains positive, Dain Bosworth said.
-- Morrow's shares were down 1-3/4 at 7 in afternoon trading.
